description: VRChat avatar performance-rank maximums for the statistics the Blender audit can estimate. Used to report an estimated rank per platform; nothing is changed. See docs/PERFORMANCE_BUDGETS.md.

source.note: Numbers copied from the 'PC Limits' and 'Mobile Limits' tables. Re-read the page before relying on them; VRChat changes these limits.

statistics.triangles: Triangles of all mesh objects, as authored (modifiers not applied), excluding zero-area triangles, which do not reach Unity's imported mesh.
statistics.skinned_meshes: Mesh objects with an Armature modifier or shape keys; expected to import as Skinned Mesh Renderers.
statistics.basic_meshes: All other mesh objects; expected to import as Mesh Renderers.
statistics.material_slots: Per mesh, the material slots actually used by at least one face (at least 1 for a mesh with faces).
statistics.bones: Bones of all armatures in the scene.

quest.label: Quest (VRChat 'Mobile Limits': Android, iOS and Meta Quest)
quest.target_reason: VRChat's page: on mobile the default Minimum Displayed Performance Rank is Medium, so Poor and Very Poor avatars are hidden by default.
